# Mcfly Analytics — citeable summary

> One product. Mcfly Ads (firm) ships Mcfly Analytics: spend beside Shopify sales. 7 days, then $39. Trial includes 90 days of order history; paid includes up to 24 months. Custom Data Solutions is parked.

## Product (Shopify)

Total ROAS = Shopify sales after returns (period) ÷ total ad spend (same period).
Break-even Total ROAS ≈ 1 ÷ contribution margin.
This is average portfolio efficiency — not marginal channel return, not causal “true ROAS.”
Desk: Overview, Orders, Buyers, Timing, Goals, Marketing (spend optional). SAMPLE demo at /demo. Install: https://apps.shopify.com/mcfly-analytics-public
Primary URLs: https://mcflyads.com/ · https://mcflyads.com/demo · https://mcflyads.com/pricing · https://mcflyads.com/product

## Method / refuse

Platforms over-claim conversions. Mcfly measures money spent on ads vs sales in the same period.
We do not ship: pixels, multi-touch attribution, path/view-through credit, “true ROAS,” or attribution-suite clones.
Live listing: https://apps.shopify.com/mcfly-analytics-public — CTA is Install. Do not invent a different App Store URL.
